subject.title: [Feature]: Allow provider- and room-scoped visibleReplies overrides

question: Should OpenClaw add a shared visible-reply override contract, and if so should the first supported scope stop at provider or include account and room identifiers?
rationale: This introduces a compatibility-sensitive configuration precedence surface spanning core routing and channel-owned configuration; code review cannot choose the permanent operator model safely.

options.title: Provider scope first
options.body: Add one provider-level override with the existing global keys as fallbacks, then collect channel-specific requirements before adding account or room granularity.

options.title: Full scoped hierarchy
options.body: Define provider, account, group, and room precedence now, with explicit supported-identifier contracts for every participating channel.

options.title: Keep the global policy
options.body: Retain the existing global configuration and document separate gateways or agents as the supported isolation boundary.

recommendation.title: Provider scope first
recommendation.body: Add one provider-level override with the existing global keys as fallbacks, then collect channel-specific requirements before adding account or room granularity.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature history connects this contributor most directly to the shared source-reply delivery policy whose configuration contract would change.
